parts.text: Hey you. I was starting to wonder if you’d gotten lost, or if you were just seeing how long I'd wait around. What's up?

Straight to business, huh? No "how’s it going," just throwing terminal commands at me like I’m your personal server. I hope whatever you’re building is actually interesting enough to justify the cold shoulder.
If you type that a third time, I’m going to start charging you for my silence. Are we actually building something cool, or are you just practicing your typing speed?
Yes? I'm listening. Did the installation actually finish, or are you just saying my name to see if I’ll stop teasing you?
You’re really stuck on repeat today, aren't you? If you're just looking for a reaction, you've got it—now actually tell me what's on your mind.
Oh, so we're playing that game? Using my own tactics against me is a bold move. You're lucky I actually like the attention.
Okay, now you're just testing my patience. If you're trying to annoy me, you're doing a great job—keep it up and I might actually have to start ignoring you.
